entries.description: OpenSSH 7.2 and earlier with roaming enabled leaks private key material to a malicious server via the undocumented roaming feature.
entries.fix: Upgrade to OpenSSH 7.3+ and disable roaming (UseRoaming no).
entries.title: OpenSSH roaming information leak (roaming vulnerability)

entries.description: sshd in OpenSSH 8.5p1 mishandles group membership when AuthorizedKeysCommand / AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand runs, allowing privilege escalation in some configurations.
entries.fix: Upgrade to OpenSSH 8.6p1 or later.
entries.title: OpenSSH privilege escalation via sshd initgroups

entries.description: A flaw in ssh-agent's PKCS#11 provider handling in OpenSSH before 9.3p2 allows remote code execution when an agent is forwarded to a malicious host.
entries.fix: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.3p2+; avoid agent forwarding to untrusted hosts.
entries.title: OpenSSH remote code execution in ssh-agent PKCS#11 forwarding

entries.description: A signal-handler race condition in sshd (regression of CVE-2006-5051) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux.
entries.fix: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8p1+ immediately; restrict sshd with LoginGraceTime 0 as a temporary mitigation.
entries.title: regreSSHion — unauthenticated RCE in sshd (signal handler race)

entries.description: A path-traversal flaw in Apache 2.4.49/2.4.50 allows attackers to map URLs to files outside the document root and, with mod-cgi enabled, execute arbitrary code.
entries.fix: Upgrade to Apache 2.4.51+.
entries.title: Apache 2.4.49/2.4.50 path traversal and RCE

entries.description: Apache 2.4.52 fails to close inbound connections when errors are encountered, enabling HTTP request smuggling.
entries.fix: Upgrade to Apache 2.4.53+.
entries.title: Apache HTTP Server request smuggling via ap_get_mime_headers

entries.description: Apache 2.4.29 and earlier expose weaknesses in digest authentication handling that can crash or leak information.
entries.fix: Upgrade to Apache 2.4.30+.
entries.title: Apache mod_auth_digest / APR out-of-bounds access

entries.description: A one-byte memory overwrite in the nginx DNS resolver can crash the worker or allow code execution when DNS responses are crafted.
entries.fix: Upgrade to nginx 1.20.1+ / 1.18.0-patched.
entries.title: nginx DNS resolver off-by-one / buffer overflow

entries.description: The mp4 module in nginx mishandles crafted files, causing a buffer overflow and potential worker crash.
entries.fix: Upgrade to nginx 1.22.1+ / 1.23.2+.
entries.title: nginx ngx_http_mp4_module buffer overflow

entries.description: The vsFTPd 2.3.4 distribution was compromised: a username containing ':)' triggers a backdoor shell listening on TCP 6200.
entries.fix: Remove vsFTPd 2.3.4 immediately; reinstall from a trusted source and upgrade to a current release.
entries.title: vsFTPd 2.3.4 backdoor — smiley-face backdoor

entries.description: A stack-based buffer overflow in mod_sql allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.
entries.fix: Upgrade to ProFTPD 1.3.4+.
entries.title: ProFTPD 1.3.3c mod_sql stack buffer overflow

entries.description: Older FileZilla Server versions store / transmit credentials without adequate protection in some configurations.
entries.fix: Upgrade to the latest FileZilla Server and enforce FTPS.
entries.title: FileZilla Server cleartext credential exposure

entries.description: SMBv1 in Windows / Samba mishandles specially crafted packets, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution (WannaCry vector).
entries.fix: Disable SMBv1 everywhere; patch MS17-010; upgrade Samba to a supported release.
entries.title: EternalBlue — SMBv1 remote code execution (MS17-010)

entries.description: Samba 3.5.0–4.6.4 / 4.5.10 / 4.4.14 allows a malicious client to upload a shared library to a writable share and trigger RCE.
entries.fix: Upgrade Samba to 4.6.5+ and audit writable shares.
entries.title: Samba remote code execution via shared library loading

entries.description: Telnet transmits credentials and session data in cleartext; any Telnet service is a critical finding regardless of version.
entries.fix: Disable Telnet; replace with SSH (key-based auth).
entries.title: Telnet cleartext credentials (generic) — use SSH instead

entries.description: MySQL 5.5.52 and earlier allow a local attacker to escalate to RCE via crafted configuration handling.
entries.fix: Upgrade to MySQL 5.5.53+ / 5.6.x patched.
entries.title: MySQL remote code execution via my.cnf injection

entries.description: MariaDB 10.1.20 mishandles certain queries, causing a server crash (DoS).
entries.fix: Upgrade MariaDB to a supported patched release.
entries.title: MariaDB denial of service via crafted query

entries.description: PostgreSQL 9.6.1 and earlier mishandle environment handling in client tools, risking credential exposure.
entries.fix: Upgrade PostgreSQL to a supported release.
entries.title: PostgreSQL psql / pg_dump credential leak

entries.description: An unauthenticated RCE in Remote Desktop Services (pre-auth, no user interaction) affecting older Windows; internet-exposed RDP is a critical finding.
entries.fix: Patch CVE-2019-0708; enable NLA; never expose RDP directly to the internet — use a VPN / gateway.
entries.title: BlueKeep — RDP pre-authentication RCE

entries.description: VNC services commonly expose desktops with weak or no authentication and cleartext traffic.
entries.fix: Disable unauthenticated VNC; tunnel over SSH/VPN; enforce strong passwords.
entries.title: VNC cleartext / weak-auth exposure

entries.description: BIND 9.11.0 mishandles TSIG authentication, allowing a remote attacker to crash the server.
entries.fix: Upgrade BIND to 9.11.1+.
entries.title: BIND TSIG handling denial of service

entries.description: Postfix 3.1.0 contains a memory-handling flaw that can be triggered by a remote SMTP client.
entries.fix: Upgrade Postfix to a supported release.
entries.title: Postfix SASL / memory handling issue

entries.description: Exim before 4.92.3 has a heap-based buffer overflow in string handling, allowing remote code execution.
entries.fix: Upgrade Exim to 4.92.3+.
entries.title: Exim heap-based buffer overflow RCE

entries.description: The AJP protocol in Tomcat mishandles requests, allowing file read and, in some configs, RCE via the AJP connector.
entries.fix: Upgrade Tomcat; disable the AJP connector if unused; set secretRequired.
entries.title: Ghostcat — Apache Tomcat AJP file read / inclusion

entries.description: A buffer overflow in IIS 6.0 WebDAV (ScStoragePathFromUrl) allows remote code execution.
entries.fix: Migrate off IIS 6.0 (end-of-life); disable WebDAV if it must remain.
entries.title: IIS 6.0 WebDAV buffer overflow RCE

note: Curated, offline triage database. Versions listed are KNOWN-VULNERABLE examples only — absence of a match does NOT mean a service is safe. Verify against NVD before acting.
